sources.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-Sante · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: With 124B total parameters and 5.1B active parameters per token, Sante is designed for medical reasoning, healthcare research, deep research, and tool-assisted workflows while retaining the general capabilities of Ling-3.0-flash. Model weights are available on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Important: Ling-3.-flash-Sante is a research model, not a medical device. Its outputs may be incomplete ...
